Our curriculum is designed to serve the best of the best

Build

Systems & AI Essentials

In Year 1, Systems and AI Essentials runs parallel to programming, enabling students to learn coding alongside AI from week one

  • Python Basics
  • React.js
  • Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA)
  • File Handling
  • Responsive Web Design
  • Arrays
  • Dictionary
  • Searching
  • API
  • UI/UX
  • JavaScript
  • Maths for CS

In class concepts

Data Structures and Algorithms

Unlock the building blocks of any form of programming

Web Development

Learn to build modern, fully functional websites from scratch.

Core Maths

Explore the math behind computers and how 1s and 0s come to life.

Projects you’ll be working upon

Open Source for an Open World

GenAI CRM

Achieve

Scalable AI systems & Machine Learning

By Year 2, students build scalable AI systems while learning Machine Learning and real-world data pipelines

  • Node.js
  • Backend Engineering
  • Dynamic Programming
  • Databases
  • Machine Learning
  • Data Visualisation
  • Spark
  • Mathematics for AI
  • Backtracking
  • PostgreSQL
  • MongoDB
  • Hadoop

In class concepts

Advanced Programming

Learn how to build the brain of apps, store and secure data

Database Systems

Learn how to organize and retrieve data to power your app or business.

System Design and Software Engineering

Explore how complex distributed systems are architected, planned, and brought to life.

Intro to AI and Machine Learning

Learn the fundamentals of training computers to learn from massive datasets and make predictions.

Projects you’ll be working upon

Build an Inshorts-like news recommendation app

Optimise last-mile delivery routes for a delivery app

Innovate

AI models, systems & System Design

By Year 3, students build AI models from scratch, understand underlying systems, and learn Software Engineering and System Design aligned with industry standards

  • Event-Driven Programming
  • Deep Learning
  • Networks - OSI Model
  • Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT) models
  • RISC Architecture

In class concepts

Modern Computer Architecture

Explore how computers work at the hardware level and how your code interacts with the system.

Computer Networks

Discover how computers communicate with each other, and what happens when a tower or router goes down—learn the backbone of the digital world!

Deep Learning

Learn to build your own Artificial Neural Networks and build models for image & speech recognition from scratch.

Machine Learning

Learn how machines make decisions from data. Build your own models and the ethics of AI

Projects you’ll be working upon

Help CSK Recruit in the IPL Mega Auction

Build Collaborative apps like Google docs

Internships, OS, Vision & NLP

By Year 4, students demonstrate real-world impact through internships, with strong ownership, design thinking, and a toolkit spanning OS fundamentals, computer vision, NLP, and effective use of AI tools

  • Operating System
  • Natural Language Processing
  • Computer Vision
  • Cyber Security
  • NLTK / spaCy / n-Grams
  • OpenCV
  • Capstone Project

Operating Systems

Explore the software that connects hardware and users

Computer Vision

Learn how computers understand and label images, and build your own vision systems.

Natural Language Processing

Learn how to extract information out of text, gain intelligence and build products that interact with users in Human language.

Theory of Computing and Compiler Design

Understand how code you write is translated to assembly that is understood by the hardware.

Maths, English and general aptitude.

Prep kit
Route 2 · Coding NSAT

Confident with coding basics and logic building?

How it works

Admission Process

Your gateway to NST

  1. 01

    Register for NSAT

    Pay the NSAT fee and register

  2. 02

    Appear for NSAT

    Subjects include Mathematics, English and General Aptitude

    Prep kit

    Three mock tests unlock after registration to help you prepare

  3. 03

    Online Interview Round

    You will be assessed on problem solving skills & given the opportunity to showcase your projects & achievements

  4. 04

    Counselling

    Once you clear the interview, you’ll be invited to the university campus counselling session

  5. 05

    Block your seat

    Receive your admission letter upon successful completion of the above steps

  6. 06

    Pack your bags for campus & hostel

    Finally, head to the campus & settle in. Welcome to NST!

FAQs & brochure

The questions everyone asks first.

Yes. The degrees offered at the Newton School of Technology in partnership with Rishihood University, ADY Patil University, and S-VYASA University, all are UGC-approved. The program is conducted in collaboration with these UGC-recognized and NAAC-accredited universities. This ensures that students receive a fully recognized undergraduate degree along with Newton School of Technology’s industry-aligned curriculum and hands-on tech training.

Yes, the program is fully residential, providing students with on-campus accommodation and a supportive learning environment.

The degree programme lasts four years. It follows Newton School of Technology’s unique phased learning model, covering core computer science foundations, specialization tracks, and real-world industry exposure.

Once you have completed the seat blocking formalities, you will receive an official invitation to visit the campus. Our admissions team will coordinate the visit schedule and provide all necessary details for your campus tour.

Living on campus at Newton School of Technology is mandatory to ensure that every student experiences a holistic and collaborative learning environment. The residential setup is designed to go beyond classroom education by fostering a strong sense of community, teamwork, and personal growth.

By staying on campus, students benefit from enhanced peer learning. They can easily collaborate on projects, exchange ideas, and support each other’s academic journeys. The close-knit residential community also helps students build lasting friendships and networks that are valuable both personally and professionally.

Additionally, being on campus provides convenient access to learning resources, labs, and extracurricular opportunities, allowing students to fully engage in all aspects of campus life. This immersive experience helps them develop essential life skills, leadership qualities, and a mindset ready for real-world challenges.

Newton School of Technology (NST) is a brand owned and operated by Incanus Technologies Pvt. Ltd., a private limited company. It is not a UGC-regulated Higher Education Institution (HEIs). NST provides industry-skilling and support services to the universities, while all degree awards are managed by the respective University.

Admissions are conducted through the NSAT (Newton Scholastic Aptitude Test) followed by an interview and counselling process.

Students receive a UGC-approved undergraduate degree in collaboration with the respective University they have applied for, along with Newton School of Technology’s advanced tech training certification.

Yes, the curriculum is the same across all NST campuses. However, the S-VYASA campus offers additional specialization options in Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, and Tech Entrepreneurship. Apart from these, all other courses and learning experiences remain identical.

Yes, international students are welcome to apply for admission at NST. For any assistance or guidance regarding the process, please reach out to our support team at support.nst@newtonschool.co.

Yes, NST offers scholarships to support students

  • Merit-Based Scholarship: Up to 100% scholarship on first-year tuition fees, based on NSAT entrance and personal interview scores.
  • Young Women Leader Scholarship: Up to 10% scholarship on tuition fees across 4 years for female candidates with strong coding projects, extracurricular/sports achievements, or demonstrated leadership.
  • Extraordinary Achievement Scholarship: Up to 10% scholarship on tuition fees across 4 years, for students with notable extracurriculars, sports achievements, national/international Olympiad wins, competitive exam success, or strong coding projects.

This ensures deserving students receive financial assistance to pursue their tech education at NST.

Scholarship opportunities are discussed during your counselling session. Based on your NSAT and personal interview results, you will be informed about your eligibility and the applicable scholarship percentage, as awards are determined by multiple factors including academic performance, achievements, and leadership potential.

You’re eligible if you passed Class 12 with PCM or PCMB and scored more than 50% in both PCM and overall boards (2025, 2026 and 2027 pass-out).

Yes, we have an official Telegram community where students can interact with peers, ask questions, participate in discussions, and get the latest updates. You can join the community here: t.me/NSTxTGCommunity.

Once your counselling session is booked, please try to attend it on time with your parents. If you have a genuine reason, you can email our support team at support.nst@newtonschool.co. After approval, you’ll be able to reschedule your session through the portal.

Upon qualifying the NSAT and interview, the option to view and schedule your counselling session will be made available through the applicant portal.

The counselling session provides students with an overview of the NST campus and details about the programs, opportunities, and resources NST offers. It also includes discussion about any scholarships awarded based on the NSAT and interview performance.

Students are expected to:

  • Attend the session with one or both parents.
  • Keep the following documents ready: 12th marksheet, JEE marksheet (if applicable), and a valid identity proof.
  • Be present for any discussion regarding fees, which requires parents’ participation.

Please email our support team at support.nst@newtonschool.co stating the reason for rescheduling. Your request will be reviewed, and upon approval, you can rebook your slot through the applicant portal.

Students can select either online or offline slots based on availability.

A preparation kit is available for students. Additionally, prep videos are being prepared, and a mock interview will also be provided to help students get ready.

All interviews are conducted online.

Please visit the applicant portal 24 hours after your interview to check your interview result status.

Yes, one segment of the interview will include questions similar to those in NSAT to assess your understanding and problem-solving skills. For the rest of the topics, you can refer to the preparation kit and interview prep videos.
